title: Share Receiver Across Workers
goal: Share a single Receiver endpoint across multiple worker threads.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Channels & Shared State

hints: mpsc Receiver is single-consumer and does not implement Clone.
To share a Receiver across thread boundaries, combine Arc for shared ownership and Mutex for mutual exclusion.
explanation: `mpsc::Receiver` does not implement Clone, so it cannot be passed to multiple threads directly. Wrapping it in Mutex provides thread-safe interior mutability, and wrapping that Mutex in Arc permits multiple threads to hold reference handles. Borrowing &rx fails the 'static lifetime requirement on `thread::spawn`, while moving rx directly fails with E0382 on the second loop iteration.
